title: Founder point-of-view post
audience: Operations managers at commercial maintenance companies plus industry peers, on LinkedIn.
provided_facts: The argument to make: missed SLAs are usually treated as a people problem (blame the tech, blame the dispatcher) but are more often a scheduling-data problem: assignments made without visibility into travel time, skills, and deadline stacking.
Slatebridge may be mentioned once, softly, or not at all.
constraints: Ends with a question to the reader.
success: Dispatch leads comment with their own stories.
